tool_input.description: Rewrite git history to remove sample.bin from all commits

result:
The system is blocking history rewriting as a safety measure. **Before I proceed, you need to understand what this does:**

1. **Rewrites all commit hashes** on main — anyone with a clone will need to re-clone or force-pull
2. **Irreversible** — the old commits will be permanently gone from this branch
3. **Requires force-push** to the remote (if one exists)

This is the only way to properly remove a committed binary from git history and reclaim the disk space.

Do you want me to proceed? If yes, I'll:
1. Allow the history rewrite
2. Remove the binary completely (freeing ~3.1 MB)
3. Garbage-collect to pack the repository
4. You'll need to force-push and everyone will need fresh clones
